🔥 The fire settles. the woman in her 40s has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "A dog-shaped silence at the treeline — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aria says quietly "So it bleeds." Maya says quietly "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

Diana leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about a dog-shaped silence at the treeline. Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free."
